belief: Benjamin Franklin acted as a spokesman/agent for several colonies in London and later as U.S. ambassador to France, serving as a diplomatic representative and advocate.

belief: Benjamin Franklin was widely admired and highly regarded by his contemporaries, being described as "the most well-known American in the world at the time of his death, and one of the most respected."

author: worker_2
belief: Historical assessments consistently rank Benjamin Franklin among the most influential and celebrated Americans, with sources calling him "the most accomplished American of his age" and "one of the most celebrated and influential Americans who has ever lived."
